legend.text: One note per sample. More of the map lit means a higher note.
More lit area: the note repeats faster.
The years travel from your left ear, 2012, to your right ear, 2023.
In the change map, a flute on the right means more light.
And a bass on the left means less light.

mappings.label: Lit share of the map
mappings.why: Brightness → pitch. Fraction of pixels bright enough to be city light: more light = higher note.

mappings.label: Lit share of the map
mappings.why: The same lit share sets how often the note repeats: more light = busier (1 to 4 notes per sample).

mappings.label: Brightness of the lights
mappings.why: Mean brightness above the land background: brighter lights = louder, brighter notes.

mappings.label: Year on screen (2012 → 2023)
mappings.why: The year label read from the video: 2012 sits in the left ear, 2023 in the right.

mappings.label: Purple share of change (more light)
mappings.why: Purple pixels in the change map: brighter in 2023 than 2012. More purple = a flute one step above the note, right ear.

mappings.label: Orange share of change (less light)
mappings.why: Orange pixels: darker in 2023 than 2012. More orange = a bass one step below, left ear.

narration.template: Night lights, 2012 to 2023. Higher notes mean more of the map is lit. The year moves from your left ear to your right.
Change map, 2012 versus 2023. Of the area that changed, {shares.gainFraction:%} got brighter, shown in purple and heard on the right. {shares.lossFraction:%} got darker, in orange, on the left.
Zoomed regions: Western Europe, the Eastern Mediterranean, Ukraine and India, 2012 to 2023.

Zoomed change. India: {regions.india.gain:%} of its lit area brighter. Western Europe: {regions.westernEurope.gain:%} brighter and {regions.westernEurope.loss:%} darker. Eastern Mediterranean: {regions.easternMediterranean.gain:%} brighter. Ukraine: {regions.ukraine.gain:%} brighter and {regions.ukraine.loss:%} darker.
